QuestInfo.name: [Stone Colossus] Royale with Jelly
QuestInfo.0: Christopher wants to talk to you in #bSwarm Habitat 3#k.
QuestInfo.1: Christopher really wants to try some Royal Jelly. Collect #r1 Royal Jelly#k from the #rGeneral Hornet#k in the #bSwarm Habitat 3#k and bring it back to Christopher.
QuestInfo.2: You got a Royal Jelly for Christopher.

0.0: H-hey, can you tell me where I am? Also, how come there's a big rock guy over there?
0.1: A-A Stone Colossus? Why did I come here? I swear I was wandering around Perion. I might be easy on the eyes, but I couldn't use a compass to save my life.
0.2: I wouldn't even have left town if I hadn't heard of this valuable stuff called #bRoyal Jelly#k. Doesn't that sound delicious? I just HAD to get some.
0.3: I even saw the right monsters... but I'm not much of a fighter, hehe. Do you think... just maybe... that you could get me a Royal Jelly since I gave you that info?

yes.0: Thanks. Please get rid of those terrible bugs.\r\n#b(Hunt down the General Hornets in Swarm Habitat 3 to get Royal Jelly.)#k

no.0: Aw, I really wanted to eat it.

1.0: That's the Royal Jelly? Gimme gimme!

yes.0: Look at that luster... Yup, this must be the Royal Jelly.

item.0: Could you maybe get me a Royal Jelly since I gave you that info? I'll be sure to compensate you.\r\n#b(Hunt down the General Hornet to get Royal Jelly.)#k
